completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.

original_deferral.reason: The tongue compared with a swift scribe's reed and the speaker's good word and works for the king have no sufficiently particular external comparison established beyond speaking or writing in general.

source_verse.text: My heart poured forth a good word; I speak my works to the king; my tongue is the reed of a swiftly writing scribe.

original_deferral.reason: The command to gird a sword at the thigh addresses an unnamed royal warrior. Generic equipment or a battle account would not establish a specific relationship or identify this king.

source_verse.text: Gird your sword upon your thigh, mighty one, in your fairness and your beauty,

original_deferral.reason: The fragrant garments and ivory palaces are not identified with the Mosaic holy oil. The separately read recipe shares myrrh but has other ingredients, including iris, and does not establish the same substance or rite.

source_verse.text: Myrrh, stacte and cassia come from your garments, from ivory palaces, from which they gladdened you.

original_deferral.reason: The king's daughter, inward glory and gold-fringed embroidery do not establish identity with priestly garments, a named royal woman or a particular sanctuary object.

source_verse.text: All the glory of the king’s daughter is within; she is arrayed in gold-fringed, varied embroidery.

original_deferral.reason: Sons replacing fathers and appointment as rulers throughout the earth are not tied to a named dynasty or genealogy in the actual verse; no such identity is supplied.

source_verse.text: In place of your fathers, sons were born unto you; you will establish them as rulers over all the earth.

original_deferral.reason: The prohibition of fear when a person grows rich and his house's glory increases has no sufficiently particular external comparison established beyond general warnings about wealth.

source_verse.text: Do not fear when a person grows rich and when the glory of his house increases.

original_deferral.reason: God's ownership of forest animals, mountain beasts and cattle is preserved as this enumeration. No exact external enumeration was established, and the absent familiar thousand-hills wording is not supplied.

source_verse.text: For all the forest’s wild animals are Mine, beasts on the mountains and cattle.

original_deferral.reason: The troubled heart and dread of death are preserved; a generic similarity to another frightened person would not establish a sufficiently particular connection.

source_verse.text: My heart was troubled within me, and dread of death fell upon me.

original_deferral.reason: The counterfactual ability to endure an enemy's reproach or hide from a hater is preserved within the intimate-betrayal complaint; it does not establish a named betrayer for this unit.

source_verse.text: For if an enemy had reproached me, I would have endured it; and if the one hating me had boasted against me, I would have hidden from him.

original_deferral.reason: The enemies detested the speaker's words and thought evil against him. Detested is not replaced with twisted, and no more particular comparison of the actual wording is established.

source_verse.text: All day they detested my words; all their thoughts against me are for evil.

original_deferral.reason: God as hope and a tower of strength before the enemy is preserved. The read Proverbs candidate speaks of greatness of strength, the Lord's name and runners raised high, but does not contain the anticipated tower; that proposed tower match is unestablished.

source_verse.text: Thou didst guide me, for Thou becamest my hope, a tower of strength before the enemy.

original_deferral.reason: The trap and afflictions upon the back are not assigned to Egyptian slavery or another named captivity from these images alone.

source_verse.text: Thou broughtest us into the trap; Thou didst place afflictions upon our back.

original_deferral.reason: The divine King's processions in the holy place do not establish the particular ark procession in Chronicles. That historical identification remains a zero-credit candidate.

source_verse.text: Thy processions were seen, God, the processions of my God, the King in the holy place.

original_deferral.reason: God's knowledge of reproach, shame and the people afflicting the speaker who are before Him remains this lament; it does not identify a separate trial scene or a particular historical group.

source_verse.text: For Thou knowest my reproach, shame and embarrassment; all those afflicting me are before Thee.

original_deferral.reason: The request to add lawlessness to lawlessness and bar entry into divine righteousness is not flattened into an ordinary forgiveness or judgment formula.

source_verse.text: Add lawlessness to their lawlessness, and let them not enter Thy righteousness.

original_deferral.reason: Being a portent to many and having God's strong help do not identify the particular sign-children in Isaiah or another named portent.

source_verse.text: I became like a portent to the many, and Thou art a mighty helper.

original_deferral.reason: Mountains taking up peace and hills righteousness are not identified with named rulers or transformed into an ordinary agricultural blessing.

source_verse.text: Let the mountains take up peace for Thy people, and the hills in righteousness.

original_deferral.reason: Entering the sanctuary changes understanding of the sinners' last things. Generic sanctuary or judgment language alone has not established a sufficiently particular independent match.

source_verse.text: until I enter God’s sanctuary and understand their last things.

original_deferral.reason: The actual line combines uncomprehending hearts, sleep and men of wealth finding nothing with their hands. It is not converted into a conventional slain-warriors translation.

source_verse.text: All those without understanding in heart were troubled; they slept their sleep, and all the men of wealth found nothing with their hands.

original_deferral.reason: The combined summons to bow, fall and weep before the Maker is preserved. Weep is not changed to kneel, and a generic worship command alone is not an independent specific counterpart.

source_verse.text: Come, let us bow down and fall before Him, and let us weep before the Lord who made us.

original_deferral.reason: The source explicitly denies treatment or repayment according to sins. Ezra 9:13 says God lightened lawless deeds and gave deliverance, but does not expressly describe a lesser punishment. That proposed punitive equivalence remains uncredited; no sufficiently particular supported alternative is retained.

source_verse.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us according to our lawless deeds,

original_deferral.reason: Animals drinking and wild donkeys quenching thirst are stated specifically. A general account of wild donkeys or divine food provision would not establish a particular independent drinking comparison; none is retained.

source_verse.text: They give drink to all the beasts of the field; wild donkeys will receive it for their thirst.

original_deferral.reason: The unit describes human work and labor until evening. An ordinary narrative of someone working or returning in the evening would be too general to establish a particular relationship; no supported comparison is retained.

source_verse.text: A man will go out to his work and to his labor until evening.

original_deferral.reason: Taking the cup of salvation and calling on the Lord is preserved. A Eucharistic identification from the checked cup-of-blessing passage remains unestablished, and no particular supported cup counterpart is retained in this pass.

source_verse.text: I will take the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord.

original_deferral.reason: The speaker asks how many the servant’s days are and when judgment against pursuers will occur. No stated duration, identified pursuit or particular judgment episode resolves these questions; no chronology was inferred.

source_verse.text: How many are the days of Thy servant? When wilt Thou give me judgment against those who pursue me?

original_deferral.reason: The speaker did not turn from judgments because God instructed him. A particular relationship beyond general divine teaching and persevering obedience was not established.

source_verse.text: I did not turn away from Thy judgments, for Thou didst instruct me.

original_deferral.reason: The speaker reckoned all sinners as transgressors and therefore loved testimonies. The unit does not describe God removing people like dross; no counterpart to the actual speaker’s reckoning was established.

source_verse.text: I reckoned all the sinners of the earth as transgressors; therefore I loved Thy testimonies continually.

original_deferral.reason: The speaker claims to have done judgment and righteousness and asks not to be handed to wrongdoers. No particular adjudicated case or sufficiently distinctive parallel beyond a general claim of just conduct was established.

source_verse.text: Sixteen: Ain. I did judgment and righteousness; do not hand me over to those who wrong me.

original_deferral.reason: The full storehouses and sheep multiplying are kept in their own whose/their sequence. The researched general agricultural richness does not establish this particular combined scene or the owners’ identity.

source_verse.text: Their storehouses full, pouring forth from this to that; their sheep bearing many young, multiplying in their outgoing places.

original_deferral.reason: Fat oxen, no collapse of a fence, no passage out and no cry in squares remain as written. No particular historical security scene or unexpressed translation of these clauses is established.

source_verse.text: Their oxen fat; there is no collapse of a fence and no passage out, nor any cry in their squares.

original_deferral.reason: Strengthened gate bars and blessed children in Jerusalem are not explicitly tied to Nehemiah’s gate-watch orders. The inspected narrative says the doors were wedged fast and guards appointed; that does not identify this praise with the narrated event.

source_verse.text: For He strengthened the bars of your gates; He blessed your children within you.

original_deferral.reason: The sent oracle and swiftly running word require a more particular counterpart than the general effectiveness of God’s sent word. The inspected Isaiah rain-and-word comparison does not expressly state the running or speed.

source_verse.text: He sends His oracle to the earth; His word will run swiftly,

original_deferral.reason: The young men, young women, old and younger people extend the praise summons across ages. No particular independent assembly or ritual is identified merely from such a general enumeration.

source_verse.text: young men and young women, old people with younger people.

original_deferral.reason: The written judgment remains unnamed. The examined vengeance statement in Deuteronomy does not establish that it is the exact written judgment intended here; no particular document or execution event is credited.

source_verse.text: to execute upon them a written judgment. This is glory for all His holy ones.

original_deferral.source_text: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor doze with your eyelids,
original_deferral.reason: The no-sleep command is an urgent step within the guarantee-release instruction. No independently precise target for this particular step was retained.

source_verse.text: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor doze with your eyelids,
source_verse.display_text: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor doze with your eyelids,

original_deferral.source_text: Everything is against a foolish man, but wise lips are weapons of discernment.
original_deferral.reason: The source contrasts everything opposing a fool with wise lips as weapons of discernment. Reviewed speech passages do not establish a sufficiently specific counterpart for this distinctive image.

source_verse.text: Everything is against a foolish man, but wise lips are weapons of discernment.
source_verse.display_text: Everything is against a foolish man, but wise lips are weapons of discernment.

original_deferral.source_text: In gladness sorrow does not mingle, but in the end joy comes to mourning.
original_deferral.reason: The text says sorrow does not mingle in gladness and that joy finally comes to mourning. No specific reviewed target resolves the sequence well enough for a retained connection.

source_verse.text: In gladness sorrow does not mingle, but in the end joy comes to mourning.
source_verse.display_text: In gladness sorrow does not mingle, but in the end joy comes to mourning.

original_deferral.reason: The source says wise and understanding people are called worthless, while sweet speakers hear more. The familiar prudent-recognition interpretation cannot be assumed; no secure target was established.

source_verse.text: They call the wise and understanding worthless, but those sweet in speech will hear more.
source_verse.display_text: They call the wise and understanding worthless, but those sweet in speech will hear more.

original_deferral.source_text: The righteous is his own accuser in the opening speech, but when the opponent presses in, he is reproved.

source_verse.text: Do not hand a household servant over into a master’s hands, lest he curse you and you be destroyed.
